query: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT cmt.receivable_id) as receivables_com_ticks, SUM(cmt.ticked) as total_ticked FROM collection_manual_ticks cmt INNER JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = cmt.receivable_id WHERE ar.estado = 'EMITIDO' AND ar.vencimentoData < '2026-05-11T00:00:00';
